ios.title: Silence every notification on iPhone
ios.intro: A web app can't turn on Do Not Disturb by itself, so create a Focus once and switch it on before each session:
steps: Open Settings → Focus and tap the + button, then choose Custom and name it "ONMi".
Under Allowed Notifications, leave People and Apps empty so nothing gets through.
Before each session, open Control Center, tap Focus and choose "ONMi".
When you finish, switch it off the same way.
ios.note: iOS doesn't list installed web apps (the ONMi home screen icon) when you automate a Focus by app, so it can't turn on by itself. Steps may vary slightly between iOS versions.

reminder.title: Turn on Do Not Disturb first
reminder.body: ONMi can't silence your phone, but you can in a couple of taps.
reminder.how: Open Control Center and turn on Do Not Disturb or your Focus (on Android, pull down the quick settings), then start your session.
